meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成生成可安全跳转的 2D/3D 关键帧动画，包括 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、Anime.js、WAAPI、FLIP、路径、遮罩、SVG 变形/绘制、文字轨迹、3D 深度等，并执行诊断验证。
howto.when: 当你需要为 HyperFrames 合成添加关键帧动画，或进行 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断时触发。不用于场景策略、品牌设计、媒体素材、字幕或通用视频规划。

say.text: 为这个合成添加一个从左侧滑入的 GSAP 关键帧动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成 GSAP 时间线代码并注册到合成。

say.text: 用 CSS 关键帧让这个元素淡入并放大。
say.note: Claude 会创建有限次数的 CSS 动画并设置填充模式。

say.text: 检查这个合成的关键帧是否有错误。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames compositions, including GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, and runs diagnostics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need keyframe animations for a HyperFrames composition or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

say_en.text: Add a GSAP keyframe animation that slides in from the left for this composition.
say_en.note: Claude generates GSAP timeline code and registers it.

say_en.text: Use CSS keyframes to fade in and scale up this element.
say_en.note: Claude creates a finite CSS animation with fill mode.

say_en.text: Check this composition's keyframes for errors.
